title: Standardize interactive states in AiToolbar, MessageBubble, QuickPanel
description: Remove one-off inline styles and non-standard hover/focus/disabled patterns from AiToolbar.tsx, MessageBubble.tsx, and QuickPanel.tsx. Replace with shared Tailwind utilities: hover:bg-gray-100 dark:hover:bg-dark-bg, focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-primary-500/50, disabled:opacity-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed.
action: In AiToolbar.tsx, MessageBubble.tsx, QuickPanel.tsx: (1) remove any style={{ }} inline style objects on interactive elements; (2) add focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-primary-500/50 focus-visible:outline-none to all <button> elements missing it; (3) ensure disabled buttons use 'disabled:opacity-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:active:scale-100' not custom opacity values; (4) normalize hover states to hover:bg-gray-100 dark:hover:bg-dark-bg on icon buttons.

convergence.definition_of_done: All interactive elements in the three components have consistent focus-visible rings. No inline style objects on buttons. Disabled states use standard Tailwind utilities.

files.change: Add focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-primary-500/50, remove inline style objects

implementation: Step 1 — Read each file. Find all <button> elements.
Step 2 — For each button: if it lacks 'focus-visible:ring-2', add 'focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-primary-500/50' to its className.
Step 3 — Find any style={{ }} prop on <button> elements. Move the styles to Tailwind equivalents (e.g., style={{ opacity: 0.5 }} → className 'opacity-50').
Step 4 — Find disabled prop usage. Ensure className includes 'disabled:opacity-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed'.

reference.pattern: ChatAreaComposer send button: 'disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50 disabled:active:scale-100' and ChatArea cancel button for consistent interactive states.

rationale.chosen_approach: Tailwind utility classes instead of inline styles — consistent with the rest of the codebase and PurgeCSS-friendly.
